definition: Profit for the year after expenses and tax. It includes non-operating amounts shown in the accounts.
location: FY 2025–26 annual report, printed page 188, Statement of Profit and Loss, 31 March 2026 column.
notes: The audited statement shows company totals. Other income of ₹18.85 crore is outside revenue from operations. Prior-year tax included ₹20.87 crore in tax booked for earlier years, which affects the profit comparison.
insight: The table shows what the retailer earned from all its operations. Use the format sales breakdown in its investor presentation to see which shops sold more.
